plugins.name: usage-guard
plugins.description: Per-chat budgets enforced against your real account rate limits.

plugins.name: model-advisor
plugins.description: Tells you whether switching models would actually help your current rate limits.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: A dashboard of how you use Claude Code, drawn from your local history. A mod: needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

plugins.name: night
plugins.description: Night mode: Claude Code sessions keep working through a from-to window while the PC is dark and quiet, then a recap. Linux with systemd; the pane is a mod and needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

plugins.name: board
plugins.description: A live board beside the chat: commits per hour and per project, the sessions working now, and your plan. A mod: needs Claude Code 2.1.292 or newer.
